review:
Hot 4 Cash is an early Nolimit City slot with a retro theme. Four Hot Zones decide which features trigger, depending on the symbols that land in them, including Super Freespins and Colossal Spins, where reels 2 to 4 merge into one giant reel.

A Disco Wild on the centre position of the middle reel adds occasional bigger hits. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 2,154x cap. A gentle classic-style game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
